{{Nickname}}
A '''crate''' was the nickname given to the [[Landing craft/Legends|landing craft]] of the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] by the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] after the former used those to send [[Warrior caste|troops]] down to the surface of [[Ithor/Legends|Ithor]] during a [[Battle of Ithor|battle]] for that [[Planet/Legends|world]] in [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]].
